periods.label: 禄存的钢铁狂熊
titles: 禄存学园代表候补/代表
periods.summary: Renji is named in the epilogue as Rokuson's Panzer Grizzly, one of the major strong fighters awaiting Hagun at the Seven Stars Sword-Art Festival.

periods.label: 钢铁狂熊的怪力与农家气质

status.current: appears at the banquet and casually eats Tatara's poisoned bladed chicken

relationships.yui-tatara: Neutralizes her poison intimidation by eating the trapped chicken without harm.
relationships.ikki-kurogane: One of the national-class rivals at the banquet.

periods.summary: Kaga is a huge Hokkaido representative and former top-eight fighter. When Tatara's poisoned chicken is exposed, he picks it up and eats the meat, bones and razor blades together, declaring that her poison might kill an elephant but not him. His appearance emphasizes the depth of national-level competitors surrounding Ikki.

key_events.summary: Eats the poisoned bladed chicken that Tatara had prepared.

abilities: extreme toughness and digestion / resistance to poison and blades

periods.label: 钢铁狂熊被烈风剑帝碾碎

status.current: defeated by Ouma and saved from death by Kurono's emergency time stop
status.condition: limbs severed and heart crushed before regenerative treatment

personality.summary: Boisterous, brave and direct, proud of the body he built to challenge Ouma.

relationships.ouma-kurogane: Childhood rival whom Renji has trained five years to challenge again.
relationships.shinguji-kurono: Saves his life by freezing his body after Ouma crushes his heart.

periods.summary: Renji enters the third round as the only returning top-eight veteran, wearing only his Device mawashi to show resolve. He demonstrates enormous control by stamping the arena downward without cracking it, then reveals his hidden Iron Block Asura Statue, forming extra steel arms to triple his offense and defense. He charges Ouma and lands blows, but Ouma only lowers his body to draw his sword. Renji's six-armed Asura Hyakka Palm cannot move Ouma, and Ouma cuts off his limbs before crushing his heart. Kurono's Clock Lock and the regenerative capsule prevent his death.

key_events.summary: Unveils Asura Statue but is catastrophically defeated by Ouma.

periods.label: 以偷袭确认一辉战场之心的钢铁狂熊

status.current: helps Ikki and confirms he remains constantly battle-ready

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Training helper who tests Ikki with an ambush and praises his chance against Stella.
relationships.momiji-asagi: Her exchange with Ikki gives Kaga the opening for his surprise attack.

periods.summary: Kaga joins the pre-final sparring group and, after Momiji's defeat, suddenly attacks Ikki from behind with Armor-Piercing Shot. Ikki calmly redirects the force into the ground and counters. Kaga explains that he wanted to remind Ikki to keep a battlefield heart at all times, then laughs when he realizes Ikki needed no such warning. He concludes Ikki has a chance against Stella because his technique can receive and redirect even monstrous power.

key_events.summary: Ambushes Ikki and validates his constant readiness.
